title: Schedule change: Friday 09 October
body:
Hi Arjun,

Your schedule has been updated to cover a gap in the team:
• On Friday 09 October you'll work SUPPORT_L2, 09:00-17:00 (previously KANNADA_DESK, 13:00-21:00).

This change keeps you within: max 40h per week (Working Time Policy §2.2); at least 11h rest between shifts (Working Time Policy §3.1).

Please acknowledge this change in ResQWork. If it conflicts with something, use 'Report a conflict' and your manager will review it.

Thank you!
